communityAgents/agent-1.notes: Charlotte is my ultimate dream agent. She represents three authors whose atmospheric work is highly comparable to my manuscript.
communityAgents/agent-1.name: Charlotte Bronte
communityAgents/agent-1.mswlNotes: Looking for fierce, independent heroines, slow-burn emotional stakes, atmospheric Victorian settings, and magic systems operating as extensions of human desire. No high-action space opera.

communityAgents/agent-2.name: Mary Shelley
communityAgents/agent-2.mswlNotes: Seeking speculative fiction dealing with the morality of creation, mechanical wonders, subterranean structures, and dark secrets. Wordcounts between 80k-110k preferred.
communityAgents/agent-2.notes: She is extremely fast. If she doesn't respond in 4 weeks, it's a pass. Keep a close eye on the calendar.

communityAgents/agent-3.mswlNotes: Looking for clever puzzle-plot narratives, highly technical backgrounds, atmospheric fog, and strong companionships. Love clockworks and historical details.
communityAgents/agent-3.notes: Prefers very crisp explanations. Wants logic-oriented query letter hooks.
communityAgents/agent-3.name: Arthur Conan Doyle

communityAgents/agent-4.name: Charles Dickens
communityAgents/agent-4.mswlNotes: Enjoys rich, expansive ensembles, subversion of Victorian values, chimney sweeps, gears, clock towers, and themes of societal inequality.
communityAgents/agent-4.notes: Currently closed, but says they will reopen in early June. Check her website on June 1st.

communityAgents/agent-5.mswlNotes: Drawn to letters, diary entries, news clippings, epistolary formats. Seeking dense Gothic atmospheres, clockwork engines, shadows, and folklore.
communityAgents/agent-5.name: Bram Stoker
communityAgents/agent-5.notes: Loves epistolary story elements. If I can weave letters into the query pitch, she will notice.

communityAgents/ca-alastair-drummond.mswlNotes: Looking for British crime fiction with a strong sense of place, historical thrillers with page-turning pace, and detective novels that subvert the genre. Love an unconventional investigator, a deeply atmospheric setting, and plots that feel airtight.
communityAgents/ca-alastair-drummond.name: Alastair Drummond

communityAgents/ca-aoife-murphy.name: Aoife Murphy
communityAgents/ca-aoife-murphy.mswlNotes: Passionate about books with an unmistakable sense of voice, fiction that explores class and social mobility, and YA that takes its readers seriously. Particularly interested in working-class narratives, stories set in Ireland or the UK, and anything that makes me laugh and cry in the same chapter.

communityAgents/ca-beatrice-langley.mswlNotes: Drawn to fantasy that draws on non-Western mythologies and folklore, historical fiction set outside Western Europe, and stories that centre characters typically excluded from the genre. Particularly interested in steampunk, clockpunk, and speculative Victorian fiction with diverse casts.
communityAgents/ca-beatrice-langley.name: Beatrice Langley

communityAgents/ca-cassandra-vole.name: Cassandra Vole
communityAgents/ca-cassandra-vole.mswlNotes: Looking for swoony historical romance with feminist sensibility, contemporary YA with real emotional depth, and any love story that makes me cry on public transport. Particularly interested in diverse casts and non-Western settings.

communityAgents/ca-clara-whitmore.name: Clara Whitmore
communityAgents/ca-clara-whitmore.mswlNotes: Seeking YA contemporary with authentic teen voices and real emotional complexity, middle grade fantasy with humour and heart, and any story featuring neurodivergent protagonists done with sensitivity and specificity. Love books that feel like they were written for one particular reader.

communityAgents/ca-diane-osei.name: Diane Osei
communityAgents/ca-diane-osei.mswlNotes: Seeking commercial fiction with literary sensibility, stories about family and intergenerational trauma, and novels that balance plot and character in equal measure. Interested in African and Caribbean diaspora stories, domestic noir, and anything with an unforgettable voice.

communityAgents/ca-felix-crane.name: Felix Crane
communityAgents/ca-felix-crane.mswlNotes: Looking for near-future science fiction grounded in real science, techno-thrillers with global stakes, and stories that ask hard questions about technology and humanity. Love unreliable systems, conspiracy plots, and endings that reframe everything.

communityAgents/ca-georgina-tate.mswlNotes: Seeking richly researched historical fiction that illuminates forgotten voices, literary memoirs with universal resonance, and novels that use the past to speak to the present. Particularly interested in women's stories across history and books that challenge the official record.
communityAgents/ca-georgina-tate.name: Georgina Tate

communityAgents/ca-helena-marsh.name: Helena Marsh
communityAgents/ca-helena-marsh.mswlNotes: Seeking atmospheric historical settings with a strong sense of place, complex female protagonists, and stories that weave magic into the mundane. Particularly drawn to Victorian and Edwardian England, unreliable narrators, and slow-burn romance subplots.

communityAgents/ca-hugo-pemberton.mswlNotes: Seeking historical adventure with cinematic scope, naval and military fiction rooted in meticulous research, and stories set in the age of exploration and empire told with a modern sensibility. Love an ensemble cast, a vividly realised period, and plots that move.
communityAgents/ca-hugo-pemberton.name: Hugo Pemberton

communityAgents/ca-isobel-grant.mswlNotes: Seeking historical fiction set in Scotland and the wider British Isles, fantasy rooted in Celtic and Norse mythology, and literary novels that explore the tension between tradition and modernity. Love a strong sense of landscape, stories told across generations, and prose with real music to it. Particularly drawn to clockwork worlds, mechanical magic, and Victorian settings with a dark heart.
communityAgents/ca-isobel-grant.name: Isobel Grant

communityAgents/ca-james-calloway.name: James Calloway
communityAgents/ca-james-calloway.mswlNotes: Looking for propulsive thrillers with morally complex protagonists, procedural crime novels with heart, and psychological mysteries that subvert expectations. Love unreliable narrators, twisty plots, and stories set outside the US.

communityAgents/ca-lena-hoffman.name: Lena Hoffman
communityAgents/ca-lena-hoffman.mswlNotes: Looking for domestic thrillers with razor-sharp tension, psychological fiction that gets inside a character's head and stays there, and any story where I genuinely cannot tell who to trust. Love an unreliable narrator, a tightly controlled timeline, and reveals that reframe everything.

communityAgents/ca-marcus-holloway.mswlNotes: Looking for literary horror that takes the genre seriously, thrillers with genuine dread rather than just pace, and any story that taps into primal fears in an unexpected way. Particularly interested in ecological horror, body horror, and stories where the monster is also sympathetic.
communityAgents/ca-marcus-holloway.name: Marcus Holloway

communityAgents/ca-miriam-goldstein.mswlNotes: Looking for smart commercial fiction with strong hooks, women's fiction about reinvention and second chances, and romance with genuine emotional stakes. Love a dual timeline, a big secret, and endings that feel both surprising and inevitable.
communityAgents/ca-miriam-goldstein.name: Miriam Goldstein

communityAgents/ca-nora-blackwell.mswlNotes: Passionate about middle grade adventures with big hearts, YA fantasy where the stakes feel real, and any story with a protagonist who grows through genuine struggle. Love talking animals, found family, and magic systems that feel earned.
communityAgents/ca-nora-blackwell.name: Nora Blackwell

communityAgents/ca-oliver-fenn.mswlNotes: Passionate about horror that uses fear to say something true about the world, dark fantasy with folkloric roots, and stories that don't flinch from difficult material. Particularly interested in British folk horror, cosmic dread, and anything that genuinely unsettles me.
communityAgents/ca-oliver-fenn.name: Oliver Fenn

communityAgents/ca-patrick-doherty.mswlNotes: Seeking Irish and British literary fiction with strong rural or small-town settings, historical novels rooted in the nineteenth and early twentieth century, and stories about ordinary people in extraordinary circumstances. Love quiet devastation, earned endings, and prose with real rhythm.
communityAgents/ca-patrick-doherty.name: Patrick Doherty

communityAgents/ca-priya-anand.name: Priya Anand
communityAgents/ca-priya-anand.mswlNotes: Passionate about stories from underrepresented voices, lyrical literary fiction that pushes form, and memoirs with a strong authorial perspective. Interested in the intersection of culture, identity, and belonging. Love books that feel urgent and necessary.

communityAgents/ca-richard-stowe.name: Richard Stowe
communityAgents/ca-richard-stowe.mswlNotes: Seeking cosy mysteries with genuine wit and an irresistible amateur sleuth, procedural crime with authentic police work, and any mystery where the setting feels like a character in itself. Love a series with legs, an ensemble of recurring characters, and clues that feel fair.

communityAgents/ca-rupert-hale.mswlNotes: Drawn to dark historical fiction with gothic atmosphere, fantasy rooted in folklore and mythology, and literary horror that gets under the skin. Love morally ambiguous characters, slow dread, and endings that linger. Particularly interested in British and Irish settings.
communityAgents/ca-rupert-hale.name: Rupert Hale

communityAgents/ca-sebastian-cross.name: Sebastian Cross
communityAgents/ca-sebastian-cross.mswlNotes: Looking for hard science fiction with genuinely rigorous ideas, secondary world fantasy with political complexity and no chosen ones, and speculative fiction that takes its premise seriously. Love morally grey factions, unreliable history, and stories where the world-building serves the theme.

communityAgents/ca-simone-laurent.name: Simone Laurent
communityAgents/ca-simone-laurent.mswlNotes: Drawn to literary fantasy that blurs genre boundaries, fiction about artists and creative life, and stories told in unusual structures or forms. Interested in European settings, magical realism, and books that feel like they could only have been written by one specific person.

communityAgents/ca-tom-ashworth.mswlNotes: Seeking epic fantasy with intricate world-building and political depth, science fiction that uses speculative elements to explore human nature, and any story that makes me see the world differently. Big fan of found family narratives, anti-heroes, and prose that sings.
communityAgents/ca-tom-ashworth.name: Tom Ashworth

communityAgents/ca-valentina-cruz.name: Valentina Cruz
communityAgents/ca-valentina-cruz.mswlNotes: Passionate about magical realism that uses the fantastical to illuminate emotional truth, literary fiction in translation or inspired by non-English language traditions, and stories about grief, memory, and the persistence of the past. Love beautiful sentences, ambiguous endings, and books that haunt me.
